Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

ggseg.meshes (development version)

Breaking changes

  • Cortical coordinates are FreeSurfer’s native axes: x left-right, y anterior-posterior, z superior-inferior. They were stored rotated 90 degrees, and ggseg3d rotated them back, so the pair was a round trip to identity for the only consumer there was. Code reading these meshes directly and relying on the rotated convention needs its axes swapped: old x is now y, old y is now -x. Faces are unchanged, so atlas vertex indices still address the same vertices.

New features

  • Every mesh carries a ggseg.formats::mesh_space() recording its vertex space, hemisphere, whether the coordinates are anatomical and the mapping to MNI305, so a consumer places a point from what the mesh says rather than from which package it came from. pial, white, smoothwm, orig and midthickness map to MNI305 by the identity; semi-inflated and sphere record no mapping, every vertex having been moved.

  • Surfaces are read through ggseg.extra::read_surface_mesh(), so the ecosystem decides in one place how to read a surface and what its faces count from. save_sysdata() now refuses a mesh that records no frame, or an anatomical one with no mapping.

  • Vignette figures and the package logo are written as 8-bit palette PNGs, and the logo is additionally resized to its display size, cutting the source tarball from 5.3 MB to under 2.5 MB and back below the CRAN 5 MB limit. The figures are unchanged in size and content.

  • Documented that the cortical face table matches the ggseg.formats inflated mesh in connectivity but not in index base: it is 1-based, that one 0-based.

  • Corrected get_cerebellar_flatmap()’s documentation: the flatmap is the first 28,935 vertices of the 30,013-vertex SUIT 3D pial surface, not a vertex-for-vertex match, and its z is exactly zero.

  • face_index_base is now verified against the stored faces instead of being stamped on as a literal; an inconsistent mesh errors rather than shipping a wrong attribute.

  • The data-raw/ scripts now share data-raw/save_sysdata.R, so re-running either one can no longer drop the other’s meshes from R/sysdata.rda.

  • Recorded the remaining data-raw/ dependencies in Config/Needs/data-raw.

  • Dropped ggseg.formats from Suggests; it was referenced only in prose.

  • Moved freesurfer, freesurferformats and gifti from Suggests to Config/Needs/data-raw, and recorded magick there too. All four are used only by the mesh- and figure-building scripts in data-raw/, which is not part of the built package, so checking or installing ggseg.meshes no longer asks for them.

  • Documentation is regenerated with roxygen2 8.1.0, matching the rest of the ggsegverse packages.

Bug fixes

  • The mesh_space tests now require ggseg.formats (>= 0.0.4.9032) to skip on, instead of erroring against a release that has no get_mesh_space().
  • Dropped the ggseg.formats::mesh_space() cross-reference anchor from get_cortical_mesh(); it was a missing link until that version is released.
  • Removed the unreachable switch() fallbacks in get_cortical_mesh() and get_cerebellar_flatmap(); match.arg() has already rejected the input.

ggseg.meshes 0.0.1

CRAN release: 2026-04-09

New features

  • Cortical fsaverage5 surfaces: pial, white, midthickness, semi-inflated, sphere, smoothwm, orig
  • SUIT cerebellar flatmap surface
  • get_cortical_mesh() for accessing cortical surfaces by hemisphere and type
  • get_cerebellar_flatmap() for the SUIT flatmap mesh
  • available_cortical_surfaces() and available_cerebellar_surfaces() for discovery
